pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding positions (no falling knife scaling) within 15 minutes of a prior stopped-out order on the same instrument.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require an institutional volume-weighted delta confirmation and 5-period EMA slope alignment before order dispatch to filter out random high-frequency market wicks.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate automated partial profit-taking and tighten trailing stops once floating profit reaches +$6.00 to prevent gains from evaporating back to negative outcomes.
